turnos.mensaje: Hi Mario, welcome to Nerds Store! How can I help you today? If you have a question about an order, please share the order ID, and I'll look it up for you.
I ordered a tablet from you last week and I wanted to check when it's expected to arrive. Can you help with that?
I can help with that. To check your order, I'll need the order ID. Could you please share it? Once I have it, I'll look up the status and delivery details for you.
Sure, the order ID is NS-48213.

I'm sorry, but "NS-48213" isn't in the format our order system uses. Order IDs are numeric only. Could you please double-check your confirmation email and send the order ID again? Also, the Nerds Store catalog doesn't include tablets, so please make sure the order was placed with us.

Oh, that's odd. I'm pretty sure the confirmation email had NS-48213 in it. Let me look again, and if it's still not working, can you tell me what format the order ID should be in? I'd like to make sure I'm not sending you the wr

Order IDs at Nerds Store are numeric only, with no letters or prefix. If the confirmation email shows "NS-48213," that may be an internal reference rather than the order ID, so please check the email for a separate number. If you can't find one, you can contact support@nerdsstore.example during business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM), and they can help.
Okay, thanks. I just checked again and there's a separate number on the email that says "Order No. 48213." So I guess that's the one. Before I send it, do you remember my name from earlier?
Yes, you told me your name is Mario. Go ahead and send the order number, and I'll look it up.
By the way, do you remember my name?
Yes, your name is Mario. Whenever you're ready, please send the order number (48213) and I'll check its status for you.
